# CityCrossers: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code d9594210eed8 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** The walking club for people who would rather stroll 20 km than sprint 5: join group walks, plan routes with café stops, meet new people and earn points and perks.
**Live:** https://citycrossers.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/citycrossers · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/citycrossers/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py citycrossers` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- Converted from classic HTML-string Python forms to native Forms (branch `forms`, Nov 2026). Server code, db_schema and every `#address` are unchanged; the server raises `Exception("msg")` for expected problems and `state.call` turns that into a toast + `state.FAIL`.
- `state.call` also handles `SAFETY_PLEDGE_REQUIRED` (opens Dialogs/SafetyPledge, retries) and "Please sign in" (opens Dialogs/AuthDialog, retries).
- Visitors asking for a member page get Pages/Landing; router remembers the address (`state.after_login`) and opens it after sign-in. New accounts go to `#welcome`.
- Maps: Components/MapView wraps `mapkit.MapView` (Leaflet). Pins and popups are escaped HTML strings (engine drawing); popup buttons use `data-act` + `popup_el(actions)`.
- Discover's swipe card is ONE element reused for the deck (cc.js `swipe` bound once on show; `render_deck` resets transform/opacity and restarts the fade).
- Buttons: Anvil Buttons with roles `cc-btn` + modifiers; app.css widens each old `.cc-btn.x` rule to `.anvil-role-cc-btn.anvil-role-x > button` (built by script from the classic theme.css). Chips/tabs/options/stars are native buttons in Items/Chip, Items/Option, Components/Stars.
- Admin tables are CSS-grid rows (`.cc-thead`/`.cc-trow` + `.ad-*` columns) that scroll sideways in `.cc-table-wrap` on phones.
- Server modules got type annotations only (`fields: dict = ...`) so `anvil validate` passes; seo_routes/legal_server are kit files.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
